steps.eval: (() => { const div = document.getElementById('torrentFilesTableDiv'); const rows = [...div.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].filter((tr) => tr.checkVisibility()); if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error(`${rows.length} rows`); if (rows.some((tr) => getComputedStyle(tr).display !== 'flex')) throw new Error('not cards'); if (div.scrollWidth > div.clientWidth) throw new Error(`${div.scrollWidth - div.clientWidth}px wider than the panel`); const right = div.getBoundingClientRect().right; for (const tr of rows) { const shown = [...tr.cells].filter((td) => td.checkVisibility()).map((td) => td.dataset.column); const missing = ['checked', 'name', 'size', 'progress', 'priority'].filter((column) => !shown.includes(column)); if (missing.length > 0) throw new Error(`${tr.dataset.test}: not shown: ${missing.join(', ')}`); const outside = [...tr.cells].filter((td) => td.checkVisibility() && (td.getBoundingClientRect().right > right + 0.5)).map((td) => td.dataset.column); if (outside.length > 0) throw new Error(`${tr.dataset.test}: outside the panel: ${outside.join(', ')}`); } const indent = (name) => Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(div.querySelector(`tr[data-test="${name}"]`)).paddingLeft); if (!((indent('Sintel Open Movie Collection') < indent('sintel')) && (indent('sintel') < indent('extras')) && (indent('extras') < indent('making-of.mp4')))) throw new Error('not indented by depth'); const header = document.querySelector('#torrentFilesTableFixedHeaderDiv tr'); if ((getComputedStyle(header).display !== 'flex') || !document.getElementById('tristate_cb').checkVisibility()) throw new Error('header is not a row of sort buttons with the check box'); return rows.map((tr) => `${tr.dataset.test}: ${Math.round(tr.getBoundingClientRect().height)}px`); })()
